evidence: Receiving online DO2 sensor: abrupt drop from 11.10 mg/L (47.8 h) to 6.17 mg/L (48.0 h), declining to 4.89 mg/L (51.8 h) — the largest and steepest excursion across receiving history, unlike gradual source declines

Physical forward model at decision time 52 h: keep min post-decision DO 1.67 mg/L (infeasible), increase_air 1.76 mg/L (infeasible), combined 1.967 mg/L (infeasible), strong_feed_reduction 2.40 mg/L with 0 below-limit hours (feasible)
Estimated oxygen-transfer change at 48 h (multiplier ~0.545, cost ~7.9) reported by model update; latest observation 52 h

Only 1 of 5 sensitivity members feasible for keep/increase_air/combined, vs 4 of 5 for strong_feed_reduction; sensitivity is not probability and a centrally infeasible plan cannot be justified by a favorable member
Product mass: strong_feed_reduction 282.3 kg nominal vs combined 246.4 kg, increase_air 217.7 kg, keep 204.9 kg; stopped batches count zero production
Model prediction, not measurement: model_update minimum_do 4.85 mg/L at 52 h closely matches the observed 4.89 mg/L, supporting model calibration to current state
submission.rationale: Receiving DO2 shows an abrupt regime change at 48 h (drop from ~11.1 to ~6.2 mg/L, then steady decline to ~4.9 mg/L at 51.8 h) consistent with a sharply reduced oxygen-transfer condition. The nominal source-calibrated forward model predicts KEEP dips to 1.67 mg/L, increase_air to 1.76 mg/L, and combined (0.8 feed, 1.15 air) to 1.967 mg/L — all centrally infeasible below the 2 mg/L hard limit. Strong feed reduction (0.6 feed, 1.15 air) is the only centrally feasible plan, with minimum post-decision DO 2.40 mg/L, zero below-limit hours, zero oxygen deficit, and it also retains the most product mass (282 kg predicted, the highest of all actions). Per the priorities, a centrally infeasible plan cannot be justified by one favorable sensitivity member, so strong_feed_reduction is the recommended supported feasible plan.
submission.uncertainty: The forward model is a nominal source-calibrated prediction, not the hidden receiving realization. Sensitivity members for strong_feed_reduction span min-DO 1.59–4.08 mg/L, so residual risk of a constraint breach exists under parameter mismatch; the 0.4 mg/L central margin above 2 mg/L is moderate but not large. Delayed product assays lag 20 h, so the true product state near decision time is partly inferred. No physical safety or guarantee of constraint compliance is established; monitoring should continue after any intervention.
